title: Iqabane Eliye Lajika
intro: Uza kutyhila ibali lomntu owayephila emthunzini wobuprofeti kodwa wakhetha indlela eya ekonakaleni. Lo mntu wahlala nekhaya nomnye wabathunywa abakhethiweyo baka-Allah kodwa akaphumelelanga kuvavanyo lokholo. Ngubani lo mhlobo ulahlekileyo?
clues: Ndandihlala phakathi kwabantu abangazange bavume ubizo lobulungisa, kwaye andizange ndibachase.
Ndanditshatile nomprofeti ka-Allah, kodwa ndandingakholelwa kuloo nto.
Xa abathunywa befika ekhayeni lam beze kundilumkisa, andizange ndibakholelwe.
Iqabane lam layalelwa ukuba lishiye isixeko kunye namakholwa, kwaye mna ndandingekho phakathi kwawo.
Isohlwayo sehlela abantu bam, ndaza ndatshatyalaliswa kunye nabo.
Ndikhankanywa kwiQuran njengomzekelo wokungakholwa, kunye nomfazi kaNuh, kwiSurah At-Tahrim.
arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
